description: fil stores files and folders on Filecoin and returns retrieval links for sharing and verification. It includes a web app, a command-line tool, and public read-only data access for Filecoin storage records and related metadata.
summary: Public read-only REST and MCP surfaces are served from `fil-api.hugomrdias.dev`, and `fil-app.hugomrdias.dev` also documents a `fil` npm CLI that uses a wallet-approved session key for storage operations.
